From: Sam Torres <sam@forgemetrics.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-11-01T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Integration hiccup on ForgeConnector — pilot timeline at risk

Hi Jonas,

Quick note from our eng team: during the connector integration for the pilot we hit a regression in a third-party SDK (ForgeConnector v2.4.1) that breaks our webhook handshake. The engineers are debugging but it looks like the fix will take 2–3 weeks to land and validate — which pushes our demo window out of the originally planned timeframe.

We really want to keep momentum with your platform, but two things would materially help us:
- A short trial extension for the pilot (3 weeks) so we can finish verification without losing access
- A small sandbox top-up (we estimate ~40k tokens) to keep testing while the fix is validated

I attached the recent error trace and minimal repro. Can you confirm if that’s something you can help with from Redwood? We’re happy to share logs and jump on a quick call with your CS/eng team.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Torres
Head of Integrations, ForgeMetrics
attachments: integration_error_log.txt (text)

Sam —

Thanks for the heads up and for sending the trace. Sorry to hear about the SDK regression; I’ve skimmed the log and I agree it looks like an upstream handshake change. We want to avoid derailing your pilot. Proposed immediate next steps:

1) I’ll escalate for a one-time sandbox uplift while your engineers patch/validate. I typically request the CS team to approve up to 50k tokens as a temporary bridge.
2) If you can share the failing request IDs / PR links for the repro we’ll get our infra folks to review for quick mitigations (rate limits, retry config).
3) I’m cc’ing Marissa (CS) and Ben (Sales Ops) to expedite internal approvals.

Would a 21-day extension and 50k tokens cover your testing runway? If that’s acceptable I’ll kick-off the approval flow and send you the DocuSign/credit form for signatures. Also open to a quick technical sync — say today at 2pm PT — if your engineers are available.

Best,
